name: Razor Master Erthas

abilities.name: Quick Draw
abilities.description: A basic ranged attack that does minor physical damage.

abilities.name: Lava Pitch
abilities.description: The boss throws a ball of fire on the ground that spreads out into 4 fire lines. Avoid these.

abilities.name: Blazing Arrow
abilities.description: The boss shoots a flaming arrow at a target, dealing moderately high flame damage over time for a very long time. This DOT cannot be purged, but can be removed by swimming in the water between islands in the boss arena.

abilities.name: Summon Flame Atronach
abilities.description: The boss summons a flame atronach to attack the party. These should be killed quickly to simplify the fight. At around 20% health, he will summon 4 at once.

abilities.name: Teleport
abilities.description: The boss will teleport between islands occasionally. Simply follow him around accordingly and save ultimates for just after he teleports to ensure they will not be wasted.

summary: This article is about the City of Ash I boss. For the Infinite Archive version, see Razor Master Erthas (Infinite Archive). Razor Master Erthas is a Wood Elf leading the cult devouted to Mehrunes Dagon located in the City of Ash I. Gilraen says he was their original leader, convincing the community to reject the Dominion and build the city of Whisper Grove, masquerading as a decent elf for years before revealing true colors as the leader of the Dagon Cell. His unique loot is the Bow of the Deadlands and Betrayer's Axe.
